name: amazecomplete
description: Smart unified autocomplete for Obsidian: natural language dates, Templater templates, and vault file links under a single trigger.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e 'import esbuild from "esbuild"; await esbuild.build({ entryPoints: ["test/amazecomplete.test.ts"], bundle: true, platform: "node", alias: { obsidian: "./test/obsidian-mock.ts" }, outfile: "test/bundle.cjs" });' && node test/bundle.cjs && rm -f test/bundle.cjs

author: notnout
